validation.notes: #guard: barème at its 20,000,000 edge = sum of band widths x rates; 900,000/900,999 exempt; 28 % deduction cap 2,800,000; six-dependant cap 720,000; pension notch 3,600,000 -> 3,600,001 (0 -> 27,000); spouse-dependant step at 6,000,000 gross (183,000 vs 195,000)

sources: Code général des impôts & Livre des procédures fiscales 2025, 'mis à jour par la Direction de la Législation Fiscale et du Contentieux' (Office Togolais des Recettes, otr.tg document 600; Internet Archive capture 20251211205452 of otr.tg/index.php/fr/impots/reglementations-fiscales/code-general-des-impots/600-code-general-des-impots-livre-des-procedures-fiscales-mis-a-jour-2025/file.html; 361 pages, text layer; sha256 7d0df3af53833e47266f4b77cf134ac3acb14bb3e8049d1bf92ac2438be4f4c3; tg/law/rescue2/otr_cgi_lpf_2025.pdf): arts. 5-6 (family unit, separate taxation), 23-3 and 27 (pensions), 26 (net employment income, 28 % flat deduction on the fraction up to 10,000,000), 72-73 (dependants, 10,000 FCFA a month each, max 6), 74 (barème 0/3/10/15/20/25/30/35 %, base rounded down to 1,000, tax to 10; read on the page image p. 40), 78 (business income 30 %), 79-80 (13 % final withholding). Cross-checks: PLF 2024 art. 16 (tg/src/PLF-2024.pdf p. 17: same art. 74 wording), PLF 2025 art. 17 and LF 2026 art. 21 article lists (no change to arts. 5-6, 23, 26-27, 72-80).
headline: IRPP rebuilt from the tax office's 2025 code: a spouse's first franc of income costs up to 42,000 FCFA (the 'conjoint sans ressource' dependant), and a pension one franc above 3.6 M doubles its taxable half
